description:
Hushfeed v0.85.0 has 156 patches for global TikTok 47.9.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

TikTok stays on 47.9.3, so patch the same build with the same signing key. New: Remember saved videos, Fill wide videos too, Keep your place in chats, Swipe LIVEs in your Following row's order and a Bulgarian settings screen. TikTok Lite gets SIM spoof, Ghost mode and the publish date. Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer.

All 156 patches applied to the supported APK. This bundle ran through a whole-app walk of TikTok on a signed-in Galaxy S22 with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Features

* `Remember saved videos` is new in Feed screen, next to the Favorites grid options. As your Favorites load, Hushfeed keeps each video's cover, creator, caption and post date on your phone. When TikTok later marks a saved video as deleted or unplayable, its grey tile shows the kept cover and creator instead, and a tap shows the rest. `Unavailable saved videos` lists them all with a search box. It can only keep what it saw while a video was still up, so tiles that were already grey stay grey (#516).
* `Fill wide videos too`, right under `Fill the screen with the video`, crops landscape and square videos to cover the screen as well. Fill on its own still leaves those whole, so you see all of a landscape video with bars above and below it. Turn this on and every video fills the screen, showing the middle of a wide one (#505).
* `Keep your place in chats` stops a chat you've scrolled up in from jumping to the bottom on its own. Coming back from a video you opened in the chat leaves you where you were, and so does sending a reply to an older message. A plain message you send and the down arrow still take you to the newest. It starts off and sits under `Show message times` in Hushfeed settings > Inbox (#503).
* On the floating bottom bar, `Glass lens on the current tab` is the same thin outline as on TikTok's own bar now, with nothing filled inside, so the video shows through it like it does around it. The glass and see-through bars keep the glass bubble (#483).
* When the diagnostic report says the phone destroyed TikTok's main screen, it now says why it might have. Either Don't keep activities is on in Developer options, or it gives how full TikTok's memory was, since Android closes an app's screens in the background once three quarters of it is used (#419).
* `Show how long a LIVE has been on`, with the other LIVE options in Playback, adds how long the host has been live to the small line in LIVE rooms, counted from when the room started and ticking every second. It sits under the room ID when that's on too. A room opened from the LIVE feed shows it once TikTok has that room's start time. It starts off (#494).
* `Show exact LIVE battle scores` shows a battle's whole score where TikTok caps it for viewers at 1M+ (or at the server's own limit with a + after it) and only the host sees the number. It covers the battle bar, the co-host windows and the high score notice. The supporters list is a page TikTok's server draws, so it isn't covered. It starts off (#495).
* `Start LIVEs at` is new under `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms`. Pick a quality there and every LIVE room opens at it until you pick another one in a room, and that pick then carries to the next rooms until TikTok closes. A room whose stream doesn't have the quality opens at TikTok's choice. It starts at `The quality you picked last`, which is how rooms opened before (#57).
* `Skip promo lines` is new under Feed filter, with its own `Promo words` list. When a line of a video's captions has one of your words, like casino or promo code, the video jumps past it and shows Undo, which goes back and lets that part play. It reads the video's own captions, so a video without any plays as usual. It's part of Subtitle tools and starts off (#493).
* `Show the country and date under the caption` has three settings of its own under Feed screen now: a text size (0 keeps the post date's size, or pick 8 to 48 points), an opacity from 10 to 100, and a shadow under the letters for bright videos (#500).
* `Tap brings the controls back` is new under `Automatic Clear display`. A tap on a video whose controls it hid shows them again instead of pausing the video, and they hide again after the delay, or after 3 seconds if the delay is shorter (#501).
* `Burn-in guard dim level` sets how solid the buttons, caption and tabs stay while the burn-in guard has them dimmed, from 0 to 90. It used to be fixed at 25. At 0 they're gone until your next touch (#501).
* `Hold speed bubble size` is new under `Slide to change the hold speed`. It draws the bubble from 50 to 150 percent of its usual size. Since 0.82.0 the bubble grows with your phone's font size, which made it big with large text on, so set it under 100 to bring it back down (#452).
* `Fade the controls out` is new under `Automatic Clear display`. The buttons, caption and tabs fade away over a quarter second before the clear instead of vanishing at once, and a touch during the fade brings them back. It starts off (#501).
* `Date instead of age` is new next to the publish date options. Recent videos show the day they were posted, like 10-12 or Oct 12, where TikTok writes 2d ago, and today's and yesterday's videos get a date too. `Day before month` and `Write the month as a word` change it the same way. It starts off (#461).
* `SIM spoof`, `Ghost mode`, `Always show publish date` and `Show author region` work on TikTok Lite now. SIM spoof uses the same Region settings as in TikTok. Lite's Ghost mode has `Hide story views`, `Hide profile visits`, `Hide typing` and `Hide online status`. The publish date shows next to the creator's name on every Lite video, For You included, and the date options change it there too. With `Show where a video was posted` on, the country comes after the date, or stands alone where Lite leaves the date off. Lite's video data does carry it, but Lite throws it away while it reads the feed, so Hushfeed picks it up there (#502).
* `Random time each day` is new under `Keep a streak going`. The message goes out at a different time every day, somewhere between `When to send` and `Latest time`, so friends don't get it at the same minute each day. It starts off (#507).
* `Jump to a date on Favorites grids` does for your saved videos what the Liked one does for likes. A button in the Favorites grid's top corner starts the list at the year or month you pick, so old saves load without scrolling through thousands of newer ones, and Newest saves goes back. It starts off and sits under `Jump to a date on Liked grids` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen (#508).
* `Pick a built-in font` is new under `Import a font file` on the App page. It lists 26 fonts that come with Hushfeed, like Bebas Neue, Lobster, Press Start 2P and VT323, and each name in the list is drawn in its own font. The one you pick becomes your imported font, so turn on `Use an imported font` and restart TikTok to see it (#487).
* `Delete your picked posts` is new under `Pick videos to save from profile grids` in Downloads. While every post you've picked on a grid is your own, the picking bar gets a trash button. It counts down from 5 with Stop, then deletes the posts from your account one at a time with a short pause between them, and each one leaves the grid as it goes. A deleted post can't be brought back, so it starts off (#487).
* `Account facts on profiles` shows how many posts an account has. Liked videos, favorites and reposts get a line of their own on the profiles TikTok sends those numbers for, and many profiles come without them. A number TikTok left out or sent as 0 gets no line, since the two look the same (#487).
* The settings screen now comes in Bulgarian, shown when TikTok runs in Bulgarian or when you pick it under `Hushfeed language`. It's a first pass, so corrections from Bulgarian speakers are welcome (#517).
* `Export followers and following` can save a JSON or plain text file as well as CSV. Tapping it lists each choice, like `Followers (JSON)` or `Following (Plain text)`. The JSON file has the same details as the CSV, and the plain text one is a username on each line (#487).
* TikTok Lite's settings no longer list switches that did nothing there. Lite's feed filter works on the videos in the feed and nothing else, so its Feed filter page drops `Hide TikTok Shop in search`, the search tab list, `Show only mutual friends on the Friends tab`, `Latest first on Following`, both offline video switches and `Show how many were filtered`. Its Feed screen page drops `Hide the search bar below videos`, `Hide the playlist bar` and `Hide the event badge`. Every rule that hides a kind of video stays, and so does `Hide inserted cards` (#48).
* `Swipe LIVEs in your Following row's order` is new with the other LIVE options in Playback. Open a LIVE from the row at the top of Following, and swiping up takes you through the row's other LIVEs in the order they sit there, starting with the next one and then going round to the ones before it. TikTok's own picks come after them, and the row's LIVEs don't show up a second time among those (#511).
* The Feature Gate Lab leaves TikTok's paid features alone. Gates tied to subscriptions, Super Fan, paid series, LIVE gifts, coins and the like aren't listed any more and can't be saved. A backup or shared profile holding one restores everything else, and a rule saved on one before this stays stored but does nothing.

### Bug Fixes

* `Remove feed ads` now takes out the sponsored block some searches open with, the "Ad" banner for a brand with its videos and a Follow button. Searching "wildwood" showed one for a movie (#484).
* New patch, `Fix notifications on OPPO, OnePlus and realme`. On those phones TikTok also signs up for OPPO's push service, and OPPO only delivers to TikTok as TikTok signed it, so notifications sent that way can't reach a patched TikTok. TikTok now uses Google's push service there, the way it does on a Samsung or a Pixel. Other phones don't change. It's in the default selection, with no switch (#496).
* With `SIM spoof` on, pictures and thumbnails could stay grey unless a VPN was on. TikTok's network stack picked its image and API servers by the preset's country while the phone was on another country's network. The network stack now gets your real SIM's country and carrier, and the rest of TikTok still sees the preset (#415).
* With `Keep captions available` on, a video whose caption tracks don't include the one in its original language now shows one of the others. TikTok used to say the video had no captions even though it carried some. The export's Captions line counts those videos as `tracks:unmatched` (#217).
* `Show the country and date under the caption` no longer sits on the progress bar on videos without a search line under the caption. The line now goes right under the caption and keeps the gap TikTok leaves above the bar. It's white like the name and caption too, not the post time's grey (#498).
* `Hold TikTok's save button to download` works wherever you press on the save button. TikTok gives some accounts a check that only starts the long press when the press lands right on the icon or its count, and a hold beside them did nothing at all (#499).
* Record in a LIVE's small window used to do nothing when the room it belonged to had gone away in the meantime. Now it says "No stream found to record. Reopen the LIVE." and writes which part was missing to the log (#413).
* A translated caption at the top of the comments showed TikTok's raw tags around its hashtags and mentions, like `<h id="288">#flowers</h>`. It shows the plain text now, with the hashtags and mentions where TikTok draws them (#488).
* Tapping "more" on a translated caption at the top of the comments no longer switches it back to the original language. Captions with line breaks kept their original lines for the expanded view (#488).
* With the floating bottom bar, the top of the pill stuck up over the last row of Home's Community grid. On a page that ends at the bar, like that grid or the other tabs, the strip above the bar now matches the bottom area, so the pill sits inside it. Over videos it still stands a little above the bar (#436).
* A speed locked on one video and carried to the next ones by `Remember the last speed` now counts as locked there too, so pulling down on those videos lets the lock go. TikTok took them for 1x videos, so the pull just locked the same speed again and the bubble's padlock showed open (#485).
* With `Hide suggested accounts` on, following someone on a profile you opened from a video no longer leaves an empty "Suggested accounts" box under the buttons, and `Keep suggestions on profiles` now shows the suggestions there too. Both only worked on a profile opened on its own page (#462).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a pinned comment's Pinned and timer tags look the same in a LIVE you open from a search result as in any other room. That LIVE plays inside the search's video feed, which never got the room's light colors, so the tags sat on pale pills there (#362).
* `Hide Balance in the profile menu` no longer leaves a thin empty card where Balance was. Balance sits in a card of its own in that menu, and hiding its only row left the card's edges behind (#194).
* Photo saves from TikTok's own servers now send the sign-in TikTok's app sends there. Photos from a friend's story were refused without it, every copy, while TikTok showed them fine, and so were photos from private accounts you follow. No other site gets a cookie (#464, #504).
* Patching takes a lot less memory with most patches selected. All of them together now fit in a 1 GB patcher heap, where they used to run out at 1.5 GB. On a phone where Manager runs 32-bit, every patch now fits with TikTok's bundle and with the APK, where they ran out partway before. Several patches only look through TikTok's code, but every look made the patcher keep an editable copy of the method until the end. And each patch that changes TikTok's resources left the parsed resource table behind for the rest of the run, about 140 MB on the APK (#497, #460, #310, #441, #48).
* Stickers made from a video get the save box in chats now. Tapping one opens it after TikTok's own preview, and holding one shows Save media, which photo stickers, GIF stickers and AI stickers get in that menu too. TikTok handles all of those apart from its own stickers, so neither showed up for them (#470).
* With `Hide the music line` on, a video with a music line now has its caption the same distance above the progress bar as a video without one. The music line hid, but the space TikTok keeps under it stayed, so those captions sat a little higher (#512).
* `Keep captions in Clear display` shows a video's first caption when it's spoken now. 0.84.0 held on to that first caption for the kept line, but on the phone it looked for it in the wrong place and never found it, so the line stayed empty until TikTok sent the next caption, sometimes seconds later (#456).

### Build

* The release tools name only global TikTok's version in the README, the Manager text and the update steps. With TikTok Lite declared too, v0.84.0 went out saying "TikTok 47.8.2 and 47.9.3", and the README still pointed at 47.8.3.
* Three of the patch tree's own checks pass on main again. The SIM spoof's network stack file has its source notice, TikTok Lite's region patch fills its reader stubs from a list the bridge check can read, and the check for made-up TikTok names no longer counts the month pattern `Jump to a date on Favorites grids` formats with.
